summary: F2-04/EMP03 frontend smoke: Panel Empresa /company flows for Productos (edit vs new) and Inventario (ajustar) tested end-to-end against preview backend using cookie 'session_token=smoke_empresa_f204_token' for auth. 16/16 UI assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: CompanyProductsView.save(): correctly omits 'stock' from PUT in edit mode (only metadatos). parseFloat used for new product stock supports decimals as required.
CompanyInventoryView.submit(): expected_total CAS correctly sent for adjust; op_id regenerated per call (idempotency key) but preserved across network-only retry — matches F2-02 pattern.
Edit dialog pre-fills form with {...emptyForm, ...p} which still sets form.stock from product (benign since not sent), but could be cleaner by also stripping stock to avoid confusion.
test_credentials: Cookie session_token=smoke_empresa_f204_token (used via Playwright context.add_cookies to bypass Turnstile).
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed: Empresa Smoke F204, Tienda Centro, product Arroz 1kg (total 100, 40 distributed). Test modified total to 120 via valid adjust and reverted to 100 at end; left two 'Ajuste de total' audit movements as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login UI is Turnstile-gated. Easiest way to reach /company is Playwright context.add_cookies([{name:'session_token', value:'smoke_empresa_f204_token', domain, path:'/', secure:true, sameSite:'None'}]). DO NOT use extra_http_headers with Authorization — it triggers CORS preflight on Google Fonts and breaks networkidle wait; use wait_until='domcontentloaded' and short settle. All F2-04 UI contracts verified: edit form omits stock + shows stock-note; new form shows stock+unit; inventory adjust dialog shows total/distribuido, CAS 409 on below_distributed yields 'El total no puede ser menor que lo ya distribuido a tus tiendas.', valid adjust succeeds with 'Stock ajustado' toast and 'Ajuste de total' audit entry.
detailed_results: PASS 1. Panel Empresa loads (company-name = 'Empresa Smoke F204')
PASS 2a. Edit form hides company-product-stock input
PASS 2c. Edit form hides company-product-unit selector
PASS 2d. Stock card unchanged after editing name (100 -> 100)
PASS 3a. New form shows Stock inicial input
PASS 3b. New form shows Unit selector
PASS 4b. Adjust dialog shows 'total actual' and 'distribuido'
PASS 4d. Adjust to 10 (< distributed 40) → 409 toast 'El total no puede ser menor que lo ya distribuido a tus tiendas.'
PASS 5. Movimientos recientes contains 'Ajuste de total' entry
